resources.string: Not calibrated: lean is not recorded

Put the phone in its mount, with the bike upright and stopped, then tap Calibrate. Keep still for 2 seconds. Lean and G-forces are only recorded when the phone is calibrated on the mount; the calibration ends with the trip.
Calibrated. Lean and G-forces will be recorded in your trip.
The bike is moving. Stop and try again.
The phone moved. Hold the bike still and try again.
This phone has no gyroscope or accelerometer.
